sharedContractFindings.status: reported, not fixed; outside the identity write set
sharedContractFindings.summary: packages/contracts/go/publicjson resolves public property names with protoreflect Fields().ByJSONName, which matches only the protobuf json_name. The canonical contract spells the money properties with an uppercase acronym (computeMonthlyUSDMicros) while protoc derives computeMonthlyUsdMicros, so every money-bearing public DTO fails to decode and encodes under the wrong key.

reproduced.decode: publicjson.Unmarshal of {"computeMonthlyUSDMicros":"50000000",...} into CreatePricePolicyRequest returns: unknown publisher property CreatePricePolicyRequest.computeMonthlyUSDMicros
reproduced.encode: publicjson.Marshal of the same message emits the protobuf spelling computeMonthlyUsdMicros
reproduced.method: an isolated module that replaced opl-cloud/packages/contracts/go and called the real codec; no product source was modified to reproduce it

sharedContractFindings.scope: 28 divergent money fields across ComputePlan, StoragePlan, PricePolicyVersion, CreatePricePolicyRequest, Model, Quote, QuoteLine, Subscription, Wallet, WalletOperation, Usage, CreditSource, UpgradeProration, NextPeriodPlanQuote, PlanChangeCalculation, PlanChange and SupplementalRefundEvidence.
sharedContractFindings.currentImpact: latent. No routed public JSON DTO carries money today (the codec tests and the BFF routes cover only non-money messages), so no live consumer is broken yet. It blocks the resource catalog price-policy wire and will block Quote, Wallet and Usage.
sharedContractFindings.proposedMinimalFix: Emit a contract-property to proto-field name mapping from packages/contracts/proto/generate_public_json_shape.py, which already parses 03_api_contract_complete.yaml without protoc, and use it in publicjson.convert in both directions. Aligning the proto json_name instead would need explicit json_name attributes plus a regeneration with the pinned protoc-gen-go and protoc-gen-go-grpc, which are not installed on the verifying machine.
sharedContractFindings.owner: shared contracts module. Needs an explicit assignment; no line may change the shared revision in parallel.
